# ChartElement

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Custom element that renders a chart using ICanvas to PDF.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IAltTextProvider`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new ChartElement(ChartBase chart, ChartData data)
```

## Properties

- [`AltText`](#alttext): Alternate text description for screen readers (e.g. "Bar chart showing monthly sales").
- [`IsDecorative`](#isdecorative): When `true` the chart is unconditionally tagged as /Artifact regardless of AltText.
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`.

### `AltText`

```csharp
string AltText { get; set; }
```

Alternate text description for screen readers (e.g. "Bar chart showing monthly sales"). When set on a PDF/UA-1 document, the chart is tagged as a /Figure with this alt text. When empty the chart is tagged as /Artifact (decorative).

### `IsDecorative`

```csharp
bool IsDecorative { get; set; }
```

When `true` the chart is unconditionally tagged as /Artifact regardless of AltText.

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`. It is always `Artifact` when `IsDecorative` is set.
